metadata.description: Self-contained marketplace for storymap-skill — a single Agent Skill for user story mapping (Jeff Patton style).

plugins.name: storymap-skill
plugins.description: User story mapping (Jeff Patton style). Turns a goal, brief, or messy backlog into a sliced, prioritized delivery plan with WSJF/RICE/MoSCoW prioritization. Mode D (iterative refinement) detects capacity/dependency/OKR/scope limit breaches. Mines existing context (README, code, tests, ADRs, Jira/ADO/GitHub via MCP, .gsd/, prior design.md) before asking the user. Plays well inside Superpowers / gstack / GSD; works standalone.
